title: The Kiss Quotient
author: Helen Hoang
summary: A successful, autistic economist decides she needs practice at relationships and hires an escort to teach her. What starts as a carefully planned set of lessons becomes something neither of them predicted.
readIf: you want an open, steamy romance about two people learning to be themselves with each other.
skipIf: you are uncomfortable with explicit scenes or a premise built around paid companionship.

pairings.reason: Another warm, funny romance with a heroine whose needs are treated with care and humour.
Flips the set-up with a neurodivergent hero, and it is just as tender and quietly funny.
A similar brilliant-but-awkward heroine falling into a deal that turns into love.
